Choose an order to view one complete magic square. Odd orders have a semi-magic 3×3 core in the upper-left corner. Each striped rectangle is checked for equal row and column sums.

Mathematical details

A rectangle is marked “magic rectangle” only when all its row sums match and all its column sums match.
